verdict.rationale: The Voice Agent is exposed as a single WebSocket API and the companion dg CLI explicitly supports scripting from the terminal (transcribe, stream, synthesize, manage account) with no GUI dependency, making headless/CI use straightforward. Multiple language starter templates (Node, Python, C#, Go) further support programmatic, non-interactive invocation. Missing for 10: an explicit CI pipeline example or documented automation/test-harness workflow, and independent hands-on confirmation of CI usage.
